xeyes 1.3.1 - X eyes demo (the pair-of-eyes tracking the cursor)

Source: https://www.x.org/releases/individual/app/xeyes-1.3.1.tar.xz
Tarball: references/_tarballs/xeyes-1.3.1.tar.xz (once fetched)
Layout: app (flat — .c/.h at root of the extracted tree).
Copied into third-party/xeyes/: whole upstream tree, unmodified.

License: MIT/X11 (see COPYING).

Build: not yet wired. xeyes is a roadmap v1 target — once libXt +
libXaw + libXmu + libXpm + the Xext shape stub are solid enough,
third-party/xeyes/ gets its own CMakeLists.txt here that compiles
xeyes.c / Eyes.c / transform.c and links emx11 + libXt + libXext_stub.

Upgrade procedure: bump the version in scripts/fetch-third-party.sh,
drop a fresh tarball into references/_tarballs/ (or let curl fetch),
and re-run the script.
